title: TestFamily
description: One activity family of a module (e.g. PSY0 > memory_nback). File: assets/content/<module>/<family>/family.json. Also defines Module (assets/content/<module>/module.json) under $defs.

id.description: Short slug, no dots, equal to engineType for PSY0 (memory_nback, planning_tubes, attention_rules, attention_parity, spatial_overlay, logic_dominos, attention_airways, verbal_boxes, arithmetic_grid, spatial_viewpoint, spatial_cubes, culture_aero, multitask_psychomotor, english_listening, english_speaking) except english (engineType english_reading).

order.description: Display order in the Learn home and default order in blueprints.

description.description: What is evaluated and how (markdown, 2-4 sentences). Shown on the family card (US-040).

engineType.description: Key of the engine that runs this family (US-020 registry): the 14 PSY0 activity families of EPIC-03 plus the English sub-families. Bank-driven engines (culture_aero, english_*) read McqItems from files; the others own a generator (see `generatorId`).

generatorId.description: v2: generator the practice launcher uses for this family (omit for bank-driven families).

answerFormat.description: Primary answer widget. mcq: options; numeric: keypad; sequence: recall; grid: tap cells; tap: tap-on-stimulus; key_press: keyboard keys at a cadence; click_sequence: ordered clicks; drag: drag & drop; multi_select: toggle cells then validate; simulation: continuous interaction; recording: microphone self-recording.

liveFeedback.description: v2: the real activity shows right/wrong feedback live; engines keep it in exam mode.

lang.description: Default stimulus language of the family's items.

defaultDurationSec.description: Section duration used by the practice launcher and by blueprints that do not override it.

confidence.description: Confidence in duration/itemCount versus the real test. Mark `assumed` until US-080 confirms.

tags.description: Root of the tag vocabulary for this family, e.g. ['english'].

familyIds.description: Ordered list of family folders under this module.
